$comment: Authoritative pre-release v1 projection, derived from the Rust types by cargo run -p xtask -- derive. Do not hand-edit.

claims.falsifier: a commissioning run from the public distribution that cannot complete without an artifact absent from it
claims.residual_risk: the tree can show no code path requires private infrastructure; it cannot show that no operational step does
claims.still_needs: a real deployment commissioned and handed off from the public distribution; no in-memory test can show the absence of private infrastructure
claims.threat: a commissioning step silently requires a tool, credential, or service only the commissioner holds, discovered when a client attempts it alone

claims.falsifier: material of a non-public class observed at a sink the workspace never declared
claims.residual_risk: the boundary governs what the code sends; it does not govern what an operator copies out of band
claims.still_needs: deployment evidence that the trust domain holds in a real environment, which a process-local boundary cannot demonstrate
claims.threat: material reaches a sink nobody classified, or a default admits what no decision did

claims.falsifier: an operational generation that stops serving after its commissioner is revoked
claims.residual_risk: revocation is forward-only over records; nothing here holds a live process open across one
claims.still_needs: a revocation performed against a running generation, showing it keeps running
claims.threat: revocation implemented as deletion, taking the running generation down with the authority that created it

claims.falsifier: two derivations from identical inputs producing different bytes with no declaration covering the difference
claims.residual_risk: identity is a function of inputs here; the specializer is a digest rather than something this repository builds
claims.still_needs: a specializer that builds an artifact; the kernel proves identity is a function of inputs, not that a build is
claims.threat: a build varies in a field nobody declared and is activated because the variance was never compared

claims.falsifier: a routing decision selecting a resource that fails a hard constraint
claims.residual_risk: tested over fixture resources; no real capability evidence is admitted yet
claims.still_needs: two real execution resources with evidence-backed capability profiles
claims.threat: a cheaper resource is selected because the ordering ran before the filter

claims.falsifier: an assignment or crossing reaching a locality the policy forbids for that data class
claims.residual_risk: the outbox governs egress and routing governs assignment; nothing yet joins them on one operation
claims.still_needs: an inference boundary that exists to be forbidden
claims.threat: locality is treated as a preference in a case where policy did not permit every candidate locality

claims.falsifier: a fully deterministic requirement satisfied by a model while a verified tool was eligible
claims.residual_risk: proven over declared requirements; no real deterministic tool is registered to prefer
claims.still_needs: a deterministic tool and an available model to prefer it over
claims.threat: a model is available and cheaper, and a deterministic requirement quietly degrades to a preference

claims.falsifier: a binding blocking on an uncalibrated proxy, or a calibration widening a delegation
claims.residual_risk: calibration is a declared boolean; nothing here verifies the adversarial fixtures behind it
claims.still_needs: calibration performed against real adversarial fixtures rather than declared
claims.threat: calibration is read as assurance, letting a heuristic acquire blocking authority

claims.falsifier: a generation whose inputs digest covers material from another workspace
claims.residual_risk: enforced over typed records; a filesystem or build cache sits outside what these types see
claims.still_needs: two institutions built from one public core, showing neither is an input to the other
claims.threat: a shared fixture, cache, or default carries one client's material into another's build

claims.falsifier: a recommissioning that cannot complete without the original commissioner's accounts or systems
claims.residual_risk: nothing in the tree bears on this claim
claims.still_needs: a replacement maintainer recommissioning from preserved inputs; nothing in the tree bears on this yet
claims.threat: an implicit dependency on the original commissioner's identity, invisible until they are gone

claims.falsifier: an operation that fails when institution-external infrastructure is unreachable
claims.residual_risk: an absence cannot be shown by a type; only a deployment can fail to need something
claims.still_needs: a deployment proving no required external dependency; an absence cannot be shown by a type
claims.threat: a hosted service becomes load-bearing by convenience rather than by decision

claims.falsifier: a generation that stops serving, or an authorized local update that fails, while disconnected
claims.residual_risk: no control plane exists to disconnect
claims.threat: activation or policy refresh reaches out at run time, making the control plane load-bearing

not_an_assurance_record: docs/12-ASSURANCE_CASE.md requires an assurance record to bind the exact identities applicable to its claim, and states that a document, a test name, a green CI run, or an actor's self-certification is not itself proof. This register is a document naming test names. It records what exists to be exercised and what each claim still needs; it proves nothing.
